publicReleaseNotes: Oncall 0.3.0 is release 1 of hosted incident coordination beside your existing pager. Paging stays OFF and no standby is required. `rer deploy` claims the owner and retires the setup token; the owner signs in by emailed link through configured remote mail or a one-time `rer signin` link, and admin-created members sign in with their workspace name and password. Install and run gives complete Cloudflare and SendGrid credential steps, and Archive moves a local archive to a fresh hosted environment. Sign-in mail is never captured: the local development outbox is removed and local owner entry stays the private `RER_OPEN` link. The Move-in kit offers a downloadable read-only Opsgenie/PagerDuty exporter and re-imports a file after Undo, alert cards show severity, incidents declared from alerts keep it and an alert opens its one incident instead of a duplicate, and each install's held session cookie is named for its port. Migrations 0113–0116 are additive. Release 2 paging and independent standby are not built; keep your existing pager authoritative. Screenshot: .github/assets/release/oncall-0.3.0-incident-1440.png.

agentUpdateInstructions: To update from 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
